name: MIKO.MD 笔记
description: 把一个本地目录当成笔记库来用：笔记是真实的 .md 文件，文件夹是真实的子目录，同时可作为 mdnotes:// 虚拟文件系统浏览。

contributions.label: MIKO.MD 笔记
contributions.description: 选一个本地目录作为笔记库。每个 .md 文件是一条笔记，每个子目录是一个文件夹。

fields.label: 笔记库目录
fields.description: 笔记库所在的本地目录，笔记就是这个目录里的 .md 文件。

fields.label: 图片目录
fields.description: 粘贴或拖入的图片存放在笔记库下的这个子目录里。

fields.label: 删除时移入 .trash
fields.description: 关闭后删除笔记与文件夹是永久删除。

actions.label: 创建目录
actions.description: 目录不存在时按填写的路径创建，并写入一篇欢迎笔记。

contributions.label: MIKO.MD 笔记
contributions.description: 目录树、编辑器、实时预览与图片粘贴。

en.name: MIKO.MD Notes
en.description: Use a local folder as a notebook: notes are real .md files, folders are real subdirectories, and the vault is browsable as the mdnotes:// virtual filesystem.

miko.md.notes.connection.label: MIKO.MD Notes
miko.md.notes.connection.description: Pick a local folder as your vault. Every .md file is a note, every subdirectory is a folder.

vault_path.label: Vault folder
vault_path.description: Local folder holding the notes; notes are the .md files inside it.

assets_dir.label: Image folder
assets_dir.description: Subfolder of the vault that receives pasted and dropped images.

trash_enabled.label: Move deletions to .trash
trash_enabled.description: When off, deleting notes and folders is permanent.

miko.md.notes.workbench.label: MIKO.MD Notes
miko.md.notes.workbench.description: Folder tree, editor, live preview, and image paste.
